binding: The owner runner verifies a fresh signed identity proof and matches hardware, role, source and current boot before accepting the result.
semantics: Empty contains no credential. Ready means two matching copies were authenticated against configured factory issuer trust and this device identity. Pending and unavailable never expose a ready credential. This does not grant ownership or command permission.
preservation: This operation is read-only. It does not deliver, write, prepare or erase credential storage.
